scope: Piccirillo, Schlank and Watanabe report integration, shared foundations, topology navigation and regression tests.

content.catalogue: Ten Section Six proceedings chapters and two cross-listed special section reports have direct topic entries. Plenary lectures are not included in this count.

source_checks.note: Existing term candidates are heuristic findings, not established errors. No claim of a new mathematical review of all pre-existing pages is made.

build.compatibility: Static HTML plus index.xml and /math-blog/ compatibility routes.

checks: Editorial rules, prerequisite rules and subject navigation
All topic narratives and current introduction snapshots
Recorded ICM section coverage and all three new source records
Bourbaki, analysis, number theory, algebra, geometry, logic and Riehl checks
Existing topology, geometry, number-theory and analysis regressions
Integer cup-product Leibniz signs, intersection-form invariants, p-rank versus group order, suspension indices, graph degrees, K4 orientation and framing comparison
Site-domain, static-HTML, reading-UI and git whitespace checks
regressions.qualification: The ten new finite mathematical checks are included in the combined regression run. They test examples and conventions, not general research theorem proofs.

checks: Every new note and reference, the subject page and the three shared foundations render with nonempty content
No browser errors, missing resources, formula errors or full-page horizontal overflow
Long display formulas remain horizontally scrollable on mobile
Subject links, topic search and legacy query/fragment-preserving redirects work

proof_and_source_limits: The supporting algebraic and numerical arguments specified in the report records are expanded locally. Classification, Floer-theoretic, chromatic and configuration-integral research inputs remain explicitly cited where their full proofs have not been reconstructed.
Source-record reading ranges are authoritative. Supplemental long papers were read selectively; publication of the notes does not imply complete proof coverage.
Independent reconstruction of all source Kirby diagrams and comprehensive BananaSpace terminology verification remain incomplete, as recorded in the report files.
